newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Iddison in Vietnam j/v with Indochina, Olympus.
newsitem.headline: Iddison in Vietnam j/v with Indochina, Olympus.

text.p: Iddison Group Vietnam Ltd said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with Indochina Goldfields and Olympus Pacific Minerals Inc whereby Iddison will hold a 7.5 percent interest in a joint venture in Vietnam.

The joint venture was over one granted gold exploration licence covering 200 square km, five gold exploration applications covering 250 square km and an agreement to jointly with Indochina and Olympus explore an area of mutual interest of 10,000 square km in central Vietnam.

Iddison, a New Zealand-listed investment company specialising in Vietnam, said the areas subject to the agreement were among the best prospects the company had seen in many years and had the potential to host large scale bulk minable gold deposits. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
